judas.title: Judas
judas.kicker: 03 / 13 · Film · Short form for brands · with the agency Judas
judas.line: Reels for banks, telecoms, rum and credit that feel native to the feed, not ads cut down to size.
brief: With the creative agency Judas, I make short videos for brands that need to work in the feed first.

For Santander, five reels that borrow film genres: a thriller that never happens, a mock documentary, a drama that isn’t one, and two street vox pops. For amigo, Vodafone’s low-cost brand, a Halloween series called Salvos pela rede: dark woods, a haunted house and an empty car park, and a phone that never loses signal. Plus reels for Ron Barceló and Cofidis.
